business_profile.text:
Tyler Technologies, Inc. is the largest software company in the United States focused exclusively on providing end-to-end information management and ERP systems to local, county, and state government entities. Its core platform solutions span financial management, property appraisal and tax assessment, courts and justice administration, public safety and 911 dispatch, public works, and citizen engagement portals.

Tyler commands an exceptional economic moat built on high regulatory switching costs, deep local government workflow integration, and customer retention rates consistently above 98%. As municipal and state agencies transition from legacy on-premise mainframe infrastructure to Tyler Cloud (hosted on AWS), Tyler is accelerating recurring SaaS subscription revenue, expanding transaction convenience fees, and sustaining predictable multi-decade cash flow compounding.

competitive_moat_analysis.text: Tyler Technologies holds a wide economic moat driven by high regulatory switching costs, deep local government workflow integration, and municipal customer retention exceeding 98%. Local, county, and state public sector agencies rely on Tyler for mission-critical functions including property tax assessment, court administration, 911 dispatch, and public records management. Municipalities rarely replace functional core ERP and judicial software due to severe operational risk and specialized public-sector procurement barriers, providing Tyler with highly predictable, inflation-protected public software cash flows.
